text.description_html:
4" x 16" Stainless Steel Push Plate in Matte Black

Common size door push plates primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. The Push Plate is 4" wide and 16" long. Made of .050" thick high quality solid stainless steel for longevity. It is made out of stainless steel with a matte black steel. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available: Matching Matte Black 4" x 16" Pull Plate

Specifications of 4" x 16" Push Plate:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Plate Height: 16"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Packaged with mounting screws.
  • Deltana PP4016 Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
